texts.zh: 尽管已经像训练时那样准备了所有的预防措施，位于[from.target.GetName]的一名我方特工还是提出了对于他们的伪装的担心。特别是在[from.GetName]行动的关键时刻，决不能暴露出来——因此，间谍首脑[from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]请求投入更多资源来使得[from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe]避免未来的意外发生。
texts.en: Despite having taken every precaution prescribed in their training, one of our operatives in the [from.target.GetName] has raised concerns that their cover may be blown. Apparently this comes at a critical time for Operation [from.GetName] - as such, Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] requests more resources with which [from.spynetwork.leader.GetHeShe] might prevent disruptions further down the line.

label.zh: 这种风险是很平常的。放着吧。

label.en: You shall have your extra resources.
